entities.name: Fionnsutha
entities.description: A young ash treefolk of Lorwyn who bears the mantle of Wanderer after Flann.

entities.name: Flann
entities.description: Previous Wanderer who passed the mantle to Fionnsutha and died of burns.

entities.name: Wanderer
entities.description: A mantle of advisor to pilgrims, passed from Flann to Fionnsutha.

events.summary: Fionnsutha finds Flann burnt and dying after a forest fire; Flann passes her the mantle of Wanderer and her bag of magical tools.
events.quote: Flann passed the mantle of Wanderer to Fionnsutha

events.summary: Fionnsutha sets out in Flann's footsteps to advise those in need.
events.quote: Fionnsutha set out in Flann's footsteps

relations.quote: bearing the mantle of Wanderer that was passed down to her from her predecessor, Flann
